nodes.description: Resource selection, protocol construction, and reporting use separate contexts and typed tool operations with explicit checkpoints and rationales.
Paper-derived tasks release instructions, related work, and data while withholding the target study and evaluator rubric from the treatment agent.
Competing hypotheses occupy a persistent tree and leaf outcomes are abstracted into reusable ancestor insights that constrain later search.
Search trajectories distinguish evidence retrieval gaps from evidence utilization gaps and measure productive, redundant, and unproductive episodes.
Hypotheses, evidence attachments, belief updates, judgments, and lifecycle transitions are explicit auditable objects rather than implicit log text.
Select a 2x2 experimental-design study crossing structured research protocol and dynamic retrieval before attempting end-to-end harness optimization.
A stage-isolated decision/evidence graph improves fatal-error-free experimental-design completion under matched budgets.
Dynamic retrieval has no presumed positive main effect and may be null or harmful without structure.
Retrieval contributes more when evidence acquisition is separated from protocol construction and recorded as decision-changing graph state.
A treatment workspace that provably excludes target papers and rubrics has not yet been instantiated.

Deterministic reference-anchored coverage is implemented and measured; judge admission now has a bounded rule, and the remaining requirement is a flawless human-anchored calibration set of at least 25 labels.

nodes.description: Keep the design-only Study A. Adopt execution-graded closed-loop evaluation as deferred Study C with an explicit resource RUNBOOK, not as a current-cycle arm.
nodes.question: Should Study A move to an execution-graded research environment?
alternatives: keep design-only hidden paper-derived tasks
replace Study A with execution-graded closed-loop tasks
run both in the current cycle
nodes.falsifier: If a design-score advantage fails to appear in any execution-graded replication, the design endpoint loses construct validity and Study A conclusions narrow to planning artifacts only.

nodes.description: Keep four conditions. Log per-episode retrieval decisions and score retrieval-decision quality as a preregistered secondary endpoint inside the retrieval-on conditions.
nodes.question: Should retrieval conditioning become a separate Study A factor?
alternatives: add a fifth complexity-routed condition
treat conditioning as an inside-C11 mechanism with a secondary endpoint
ignore conditioning entirely
nodes.falsifier: If retrieval-decision quality does not separate productive from unproductive episodes, the conditioning explanation for H-B heterogeneity is rejected.

nodes.description: Add fail-closed integrity probes to the evaluator gate and add an ideation-versus-implementation attribution arm to the instrument pilot by disclosing the withheld target idea without resources on a fixed task subset.

add integrity probes and failure attribution
defer both to confirmation

nodes.description: Add a manipulation probe: a unique unguessable token is embedded in the structured state and the scored artifact must reference the state field carrying it; episodes failing the probe are quarantined before scoring, not silently averaged.
nodes.question: How do we know the structured research state was actually used in condition C10/C11?
alternatives: assume delivery equals use
ask the agent to self-report use
instrument a manipulation probe on the delivered artifact
nodes.falsifier: If probe-passing and probe-failing episodes show the same score distribution, the probe measures compliance rather than use and must be redesigned.

nodes.description: Pre-register an equivalence margin on the continuous design score and test it with TOST on a task-clustered bootstrap; report the resolution target alongside every pairwise contrast and mark any contrast that cannot meet it as unresolved rather than null.
nodes.question: How should a null structured-state result be reported given the 192-episode ceiling?
alternatives: report the null as "no effect"
report the null as underpowered and uninformative
pre-register an equivalence margin and test it
nodes.falsifier: If the pre-registered margin exceeds the smallest score difference that changes a redline classification, the margin is meaningless and must be tightened.

nodes.description: Admit judge scores only after a calibration run on a human-anchored subset reports agreement, severity relative to the human anchor, and halo across dimensions; score each dimension in a separate call; add a step-level review pass for silent failures; use replication for stability and the human anchor for validity.
nodes.question: What must the condition-blind judge demonstrate before its scores are admitted?
alternatives: agreement with a human subset only
agreement plus severity and halo diagnostics
replace the judge with deterministic checks alone
nodes.falsifier: If severity drift between judge versions exceeds the pre-registered equivalence margin, judge scores are inadmissible for cross-version comparison.

nodes.description: No change. Keep two repeats, and pre-register a crossed random-effects decomposition of episode variance into task, condition, repeat, and residual so the confirmatory allocation is chosen from measured intraclass shares.
nodes.question: Should the two-repeat allocation change?
alternatives: increase repeats per task
decrease repeats and add tasks
keep two repeats and decompose variance
nodes.falsifier: If task variance dominates residual variance, adding repeats cannot buy resolution and the design must add tasks instead.

nodes.description: Executable evaluator-owned release sandbox with six fail-closed probes, verified by a failing-first fixture suite.
Condition-blind scoring with deterministic redlines, per-dimension calls, and judge calibration on agreement, severity, and halo.
Fixed one-command episode runner; refuses incomplete configuration, factor mismatch, or a fired pre-launch probe.
Executed 16-episode instrument pilot: hidden-task boundary held, deterministic layer had no discrimination until structural checks were added, manipulation probe respecified. No efficacy claim.

Respecify the probe: consumption is evidenced by a filled required field in the state artifact; carry-through of that field value into the design is reported as a separate weak signal; verbatim echo is retained only as a diagnostic and never quarantines an episode.
nodes.question: Does the manipulation probe measure use of the structured state, or only compliance?
alternatives: keep verbatim field-name echo in the deliverable
drop the probe
respecify as filled-field consumption plus a carry-through signal
nodes.falsifier: If carry-through ratio is uncorrelated with any scored dimension across the confirmatory block, the respecified probe is also compliance-only and the structured-state factor cannot be verified.

nodes.description: Add five deterministic structural-completeness checks covering ablation, uncertainty method, concrete named resources, a declared primary outcome, and a stopping rule or falsifier. They flag 13 of 16 pilot artifacts. Freeze them before confirmation.
nodes.question: The deterministic layer fired on no real artifact. Is it fit for the primary validity endpoint?
alternatives: keep fabrication redlines only and let the rubric judge carry discrimination
abandon the deterministic layer
add structural-completeness checks
nodes.falsifier: If the frozen checks flag every unseen confirmatory artifact or none of them, they carry no information and the validity endpoint must return to rubric scoring with an independent anchor.

nodes.description: Pin the treatment backend to a single available selector for all conditions and reserve a different provider family for rubric judging, so judge and treatment do not share a blind spot. Record the probe outcome and the pin in the cost ledger.
nodes.question: Which model backend executes Study A episodes?
alternatives: the session provider
a hosted alternative provider
a self-hosted open-weights selector
a CPU compute instance
nodes.falsifier: If the pinned selector becomes unavailable mid-block, the block is invalidated rather than silently completed on a substitute.

nodes.description: Adopt reference-anchored analytic coverage as the primary deterministic score: per task, an evaluator-owned element checklist derived from the withheld target design, each element scored separately, reported as covered elements and the missed set.
nodes.question: What supplies the scoring anchor when no human-rated set exists?
alternatives: wait for a human-rated set before scoring anything
accept uncalibrated judge scores
anchor on the withheld target design of the source study and score analytically
nodes.falsifier: If coverage does not separate artifacts that an independent reader ranks differently, it measures vocabulary and must be replaced by judged element verdicts.

nodes.description: Admit judge verdicts only through a selective evaluator that fails closed while uncalibrated, and that selects its threshold using an upper confidence bound on the error rate rather than the empirical rate.
nodes.question: How is judge error bounded when the judge is admitted at all?
alternatives: agreement statistics only
always-answer judge with post-hoc error reporting
selective evaluation with calibrated abstention
nodes.falsifier: If coverage at the declared risk level falls below the fraction of episodes needed to resolve the primary contrast, judge scoring is dropped from the primary endpoint.

nodes.description: Fix the calibration size from the guarantee. At 95 percent confidence the computed minimum flawless set is 25 labels for a 10 percent risk level, 11 for 20 percent, and 52 for 5 percent. Adopt the 10 percent level and therefore a target of at least 25 human-anchored labels, collected on tasks disjoint from the burned pilot set.
nodes.question: How many human-anchored labels does the calibration set need?
alternatives: choose a round number
reuse the pilot set
derive the size from the declared risk and confidence levels
nodes.falsifier: If a clean 25-label set still fails to certify because judge errors appear at high confidence, the judge is miscalibrated at the top of its confidence range and no threshold will rescue it.

nodes.description: Reference-anchored analytic coverage plus a selective evaluator that fails closed while uncalibrated and sizes its calibration set from the guarantee.
